basics.name: Caio Lins Peixoto
basics.label: MSc Student in Applied Mathematics
basics.summary: My research interests focus around areas of Probability and Statistics which have compelling applications and a strong functional flavor. Right now I am working on singular stochastic control problems, stochastic gradient methods in infinite dimensional spaces, and nonparametric confidence sets for HPD interval endpoints. I am fortunate to be advised by Prof. Yuri Saporito.

education.description: Bachelor's dissertation: Nonparametric Instrumental Variable Regression through Stochastic Gradients and Kernel Methods.
